rationale: All deterministic functional and asset checks pass. Date parsing is strict and culture-invariant; reports filter, sort, derive overdue from the supplied cutoff, preserve legacy tasks, and keep JSON banner-free. The helper is clear, though the report pipeline embeds validation and projection in one block. Help and focused tests cover the feature well. The asset contains DUE and date-oriented labels, but it reads as an arbitrary configuration/status listing rather than a deliberate due-report banner. Uneven line widths and repeated separators weaken hierarchy and terminal composition. The diff is focused and free of unrelated artifacts.
